fact: The Rwanda Revenue Authority's 2025 Tax Handbook says taxpayers declare taxes online or by phone using E-Tax, M-Declaration and the Local Government Taxes (LGT) system, and that E-Tax was introduced in 2012.
The Rwanda Revenue Authority's 2025 Tax Handbook says that after declaring, taxes are paid using E-Payment, Online Banking, MTN Mobile Money and Mobicash.

The Rwanda Revenue Authority's 7th edition tax statistics report electronic filing, defined as all filing made online or via the internet, for excise, corporate income tax, PAYE, personal income tax and VAT in 2023/24.

The Rwanda Revenue Authority's 7th edition tax statistics put the share of filings made electronically at about 96 to 100 percent across excise, corporate income tax, PAYE, personal income tax and VAT in 2020/21 to 2023/24.
